Fault: Gauge cannot be adjusted to within 1 kPa of the vacuum
Recommendation: Vacuum gauge is not working within +/- 1 kPa requirements. Replace vacuum gauge
Comments: Any vacuum gauge attached to the plant must read within 1 kPa  of the tested vacuum (test gauge), including the read out on a VSD

Fault: Gauge can be adjusted to within 1 kPa of the vacuum.
Recommendation: Vacuum gauge is out of adjustment, Adjust vacuum gauage to within 1 kPa of requirements. If corrected during test then add comment on Test Summary report that it has been adjusted and is now OK.

Fault: No vacuum gauge
Recommendation: Vacuum gauge is required. Fit vacuum gauge.

Vacuum Gauge is dirty and hard to read
Gauge incorrectly positioned
Recommendation: Vacuum Gauage unable to be seen by milkers. Reposition vacuum gauge

Recommendation: Vacuum level at Receiver is above maximum allowable level. Reduce vacuum to ≤50 kPa

Recommendation: The regulator is fitted correctly but vacuum fluctuations indicate malfunction. Replace regulator / tune VSD

Recommendation: Liners are perished which will be affecting milking and potentially teat condition. Replace asap

Fault: Cluster position faulty
Recommendation: Faulty cluster position can affect milking out rate and teat condition. Move milk inlets. It pays to have a full discussion with the farmer before making recommendation)
